description: Fix Django admin interface field reference errors, search syntax issues, and permission decorator problems in core/admin.py
steps: Read complete core/admin.py file to identify all list_display field reference errors
Fix all search_fields syntax by replacing '=' with '__' for Django field lookups
Validate all list_display fields exist on their corresponding model classes
Fix inline model configuration foreign key relationships
Add proper permission decorators to custom admin views
Complete any truncated admin class definitions
Review and fix admin method references to ensure they match actual model fields
Test admin interface loads without errors for all registered models
acceptance_criteria: Django admin interface loads at /admin/ without field reference errors
All search functionality works correctly with proper field lookup syntax
List displays show correct data for all model admin classes
Inline models display and function properly
No JavaScript console errors in admin interface
verification: Navigate to /admin/ and test each model's changelist and change form
Test search functionality for models with search_fields configured
findings: Admin.py file contains field reference errors in list_display, incorrect search_fields syntax using '=' instead of '__', and potentially incomplete class definitions due to file truncation during investigation.
